messages:
alex: Quick triage — post-launch follow-on plan. We have: 1) streaming failures for some Dedicated customers (P0/P1), 2) noticeable embeddings latency spike after recent deploy, 3) a couple UX polish asks from PMs. Need to decide hotpatch vs next milestone.

mira: Streaming looks reproducible in e2e with a specific batch size/order. I can push a fix but need eng-infra to repro in CI (kv-cache warm path). Estimate 48h if infra helps.

jamal: Confirmed two customers escalated (account ids redacted). They're flagged for SLA notifications. If we do a hotpatch, they want status updates every 12h.

lucy: UX polishes are low risk but depend on design reviews. Recommend scheduling them into the next minor release unless a customer contract requires immediate.

ranjit: Embeddings perf regression likely introduced by a quantized kernel fallback. I can bench smaller variants. If we hotpatch embeddings, we must run a canary and perf histogram comparison.

sami: I'll produce acceptance criteria for the UX items and an impact matrix by EOD.

alex: Proposal:
- Hotpatch window this Friday for streaming only (owner: mira).
- Embeddings: canary roll for perf tests first; if safe, include in next sprint patch. (owner: ranjit)
- UX polishes: next milestone unless pledged to customer.
- Communication: @jamal to own customer updates.
Any blockers?

mira: Blocker: CI doesn't have the exact KV cache config to trigger the issue. Needs 2h from eng-infra to add a scenario.

eng-sre: We can carve a reduced-traffic canary route and run the perf harness. Need PR with test plan.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary cluster scheduled for 2024-08-02 02:00 UTC pending approval. :rocket:

jamal: I'll draft the initial customer note: 'We're investigating streaming interruptions; mitigation in progress with ETA ~48h. We'll provide updates every 12h.' Will ping once canary completes.

lucy: Decision check: do hotpatch for streaming only. Embeddings -> gated canary. UX -> backlog.

alex: OK locking in plan. I'll open the sprint card with checklist: owner, PR link, test plan, canary metric thresholds, rollback criteria, and customer comms cadence. Thanks team :thumbsup:

ranjit: Adding canary thresholds suggestion:
```
- embeddings P50 latency <= baseline * 1.05
- p99 <= baseline * 1.10
- no increase in OOM or error rate
```

mira: I'll add the integration test and link it to the card.

alex: card created: https://redwood.internal/board/ISSUE-4271 — assign owners and drop PRs there.
